recap_subtitle: Step up to real text coding, superstar programmers! Let's review the syntax structures, loops, and custom classes we coded inside PicToBlox to command sprites using the power of Python. The 12 sessions are summarized below:

sessions.title: Session 1: Text-Based Coding & Python Intro
targets: Differentiate block-based coding from text-based coding
Execute your very first Python print statement
sessions.project: Write My First Program - Code a script that prints a welcoming developer message to the console screen!

sessions.title: Session 2: Built-in Functions & walking Tobi
targets: Control active sprites movements using coordinates functions
sessions.project: Introduce Yourself with Tobi - Scripting Tobi to move forward, wave, and cycle costumes to animate walking!

sessions.title: Session 3: Variables, Data Types & Operators
targets: Define Python variables for number/text storage
Identify string (str) and integer (int) data types
sessions.project: Addition Bot - An interactive math bot that takes two typed numbers, sums them up, and speaks the answer!

sessions.title: Session 4: Custom Functions & parameters
targets: Declare custom functions using the 'def' keyword
Pass values using parameters and arguments
sessions.project: Cube Calculator - Defining reusable mathematical functions to compute the volume and area of cubes instantly!

sessions.title: Session 5: Conditionals & Maze beetles
targets: Sense coordinate borders and color walls
sessions.project: Beetle in Maze - Command a beetle to navigate maze corridors, turning left or reversing when hitting red boundaries!

sessions.title: Session 6: For Loops & Geometric Drawings
targets: Understand the concept of looping mechanisms
sessions.project: Square Painter - Drawing perfectly symmetric squares by looping motion and angle rotation commands exactly 4 times!

sessions.title: Session 7: While Loops & loop limits
targets: Write conditional loops using the 'while' keyword
Prevent dangerous infinite loops by updating counters
sessions.project: Boundary Patrol - Controlling sprites to march back and forth along boundaries using condition loops!

sessions.title: Session 8: Review & Ball Bricker Game
sessions.project: Ball Bricker - Coding a classic paddle arcade game, bouncing balls to crush target brick grids!

sessions.title: Session 9: Sprite Cloning in Python
targets: Understand cloning mechanics in Python environments
sessions.project: Chick Spawner - Spawning a swarm of fluffy yellow chick clones falling down coordinates when space is tapped!

sessions.title: Session 10: Catching Apples with Scoreboards
targets: Track scores and speeds with variables
sessions.project: Apple Catcher - Catch falling red apples in a bowl to rack up points, increasing speed as points mount!

sessions.title: Session 11: Introduction to Custom Classes & Objects
targets: Define custom classes with initial properties
sessions.project: Street Racing Part 1 - Defining object blueprints for speed racing cars with distinct color properties!

sessions.title: Session 12: Inter-Sprite Communications & Backdrops
targets: Control secondary sprites from main scripts
sessions.project: Street Racing Part 2 - Complete racing game with steering opponent AI cars, border checks, and finish overlays!
